# Phase 6D contract fixtures

These files are synthetic contract examples only. They are not approved Opportunity Filter
definitions, source data, or release artifacts and must never be activated or published.

The empty catalog proves the contracts-only state. The one-filter definition, evidence and
assessment examples exercise typed career and education payloads, tri-state integrity, strict AND
assessment behavior, explicit missingness, source/licence identity and the optional release-5.1
binding.
